description: The DOC Open Spatial Data portal publishes the open GIS data of New Zealand's Department of Conservation. The portal read on 2026-09-28 warns that DOC is upgrading its GIS platform, so service URLs will change and some content will be deprecated over the coming months, and its search service lists 141 datasets, among them public conservation land, conservation covenant areas, ecosystem management units, freedom camping sites, Hauraki Gulf marine protection areas, combined seabird risk layers and many seabird utilisation distributions, as well as DOC roads, tracks, campsites and walking experiences now marked as deprecated. Coverage is New Zealand and its waters. Licence: not stated in the portal item metadata (licenseInfo empty); set on each dataset page. Access is free of charge. Caveats: the infrastructure layers (roads, tracks, huts) are being replaced, so links may break, and most layers are ecological. It supports environmental constraints for infrastructure planning and hazard exposure of DOC roads and tracks, such as offshore wind and cable siting against seabird risk. Related records: data-doc-nz-estuaries-spatial-database and data-mfe-new-zealand-data-service complement it.
